depth: d0 — no exclusions, so n_known = 0, ramp_fame = 0.0 and the fame ramp is OFF (pathfinding.py:130-132). No deeper depth is measurable on a fame-free build.
interleaving: per pair: served timed, then the arm timed, so drift cancels within each pair

lba_g1b.statistic: the arm's median d0 wall-clock / the served map's, same process, same pairs

served_local_median_note: the quantity §5 records as being on NO document — LBA-M1 supplies it as a by-product of its own ratio, which is why the gate supplies its own calibration
bars: This measures the COST of serving a query, never whether the answer is good (§9).
